title: RAW UNREVIEWED: independently dated event with named before and after states
summary: A historical almanac or observation record may identify an event by explicit date and independently name its preceding and following visible states. The written date and event identity would be fixed from the primary before looking for any admitted Voynich counterpart. A word reading would have to account for the entire state transition and its ordering; date numerology or a generic celestial picture alone cannot bind it. Source availability and target event identity are unknown.

design.mechanism: dated source event independently binds state names and their temporal order
design.unit: complete dated source event and complete admitted target record
design.contrast: specific keyed transition versus generic calendar or zodiac association
design.prediction: the selected target reading predicts both named states in correct order and preserves the event identity on all nominated cases
